plant_forward.title: Plant-forward & vegetarian-leaning promos
plant_forward.why_segment: We grouped brands whose stored official homepage copy on this site explicitly mentions plant-based, plant-rich, vegan, or vegetarian meals — not brands we label as plant-only without that wording.

how_to_pick.text: Start on the compare table and filter mentally for plant/vegan/vegetarian wording in each row’s top listing — we do not rank brands we cannot quote.
When our price column shows a number (not “—”), that price was extracted from the brand page; when it shows “—”, we have no extracted price to compare.

good_fit.text: Compare-row listing: “Get 20% off Your First Box” — brand page positions meal plans for “seasonal reset” / weekly rhythm (see provider page intro we store).

good_fit.text: Compare-row listing: “Get $90 off across 4 boxes” with conditions “Across 4 boxes”; Gobble’s stored listing snippet on our site also mentions “vegetarian dishes” for a 15-minute kit — use Sunbasket/Gobble rows if you want kits with vegetarian options called out on the official page we scraped.
good_fit.source_label: Sunbasket + Gobble listings on mealkitdeals compare table

consider_skipping.text: Stored homepage copy on our site describes chicken nuggets — not aligned with plant-forward shopping.
Compare table shows an extracted $2.99/meal first-box price, but stored EveryPlate intro emphasizes “dependable prices” and easy kits — it does not describe a plant-only menu on the copy we store.

Stored Factor intro lists “vegetarian prepared meals” among many meal types — ready-made heat-and-eat, not a plant-only kit line. Skip if you need cook-from-kit plant menus; consider if you want vegetarian heat-and-eat.

table_judgment.text: Looser spread discount on our compare table today: Sunbasket “$90 off across 4 boxes” and Gobble “$120 off across 4 boxes” (conditions on each provider page). Purple Carrot shows “$100 Off” on first month but our price column stays “—” — do not treat $100 as a per-meal price.

Stricter new-subscriber language on HelloFresh’s listing: conditions include “new subscribers only” and “One per box with active subscription” — plant-forward shoppers still hit subscription gates even if the brand is not in this guide’s good-fit list.
